items.title: Je suis déshéritée (Cadéac)
items.desc: Pierre Cadéac, Je suis déshéritée, 1540. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
